headline: Fighting Shifts to Stlican Shelf as Stonecradle Falls Quiet
war_summary: Three hours on, the storm's center has shifted. Stlican Shelf now leads the dispatches: six base actions in two hours, thirty-four in a day, with the latest logged as this edition went to press. The Old Mourn, Vulpine Watch, and The Pale House saw the heaviest fighting, and two of the shelf's works stand demolished and unclaimed — the Colonials now holding four bases there to the Wardens' three, down from six at our last writing. Stonecradle's early-hours eruption has subsided; no base action recorded there in two hours, and casualty returns fall steeply. The Dead Lands, too, has gone quiet of late, though a day's toll of eighteen thousand keeps it the war's bloodiest field. Fisherman's Row takes up the running — six actions in the last two hours, Arcadia and Eidolo the day's busiest posts, the Wardens firm with eight of nine works. Weathered Expanse churns on at Spirit Watch, twenty-three actions in a day, and the fighting about Mox in Marban Hollow quickens. Callahan's Passage keeps the casualty ledgers full — over 650 a side in two hours — with The Latch and The Procession the busiest posts. On our count the Colonials hold 266 strategic works, the Wardens 168, two in ruin. It is the one-hundred-fifty-eighth day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
